findings.title: Weather countdown read future override and revealed an uncast opponent weather change
findings.original_scenario: The initial fixture started sun at presentation 1.1 s but used the future rain event at 2.95 s as its expiry, showing only 1.85 s. A battle ending before the next weather event omitted the countdown.
findings.required_action: Use only the announced weather event expiry and an explicit clock mapping; switch when the actual override event arrives.
findings.resolution: Timeline copies original simulation_time into presented tactical payloads without mutating raw events. Renderer computes the announced remaining window from that event; it no longer scans future transitions.
findings.re_review_condition: Same past prefix must yield the same countdown despite future override versus early end; override occurs only at its event, with rewind and speed stable.
findings.verification_result: Passed. Full versus truncated future have equal 8.0, 7.8 and 7.5 s countdowns and byte-identical frames at 1.1, 1.3 and 1.6 presentation seconds. Existing override, rewind, speed and skip checks pass.

findings.title: Guard participant tracking caused the surf side packet to animate as another basic attack
findings.original_scenario: Guard plus surf produced primary impact 1.05 s and a separate secondary=False attack at 1.55 s. Removing the guard marker from the same raw stream restored a secondary hit at 1.05 s.
findings.required_action: Provide bounded cast ownership for guard-related packets without absorbing subsequent independent same-tick actions.
findings.resolution: Combat closes result_event_count immediately after the intercepted cast packet. Timeline binds only those following records to the cast, preserving participation fences while leaving later actions independent.
findings.re_review_condition: Guard plus surf primary and side damage share impact; subsequent same-tick basics and later weather transitions remain outside ownership; JSON replay and base_v1 compatibility remain valid.
findings.verification_result: Passed. Surf side packet shares primary impact; two subsequent same-tick basics, including another unit, are independent. JSON roundtrip preserves the boundary. A cast-owned rain request is inside the packet and its next-tick weather start is outside. Base event/RNG golden tests pass.

findings.original_scenario: The native log could omit 晴/承 and could not reuse the special weather-only 雨/雹 fallback through the generic draw_text path.
findings.required_action: Supply fixed 16px monochrome fallback glyphs on the shared drawing path and verify actual native-log characters without runtime system fonts.
findings.resolution: UI_GLYPHS now includes Regular fixed bitmaps for 晴/承/雨/雹. Generic text rendering uses the shared bitmaps.
findings.re_review_condition: All 31 native-log characters are nonblank, retain 16px boundaries and requested colors, and draw with system font loading disabled; inspect the final native scene render.
findings.verification_result: Passed: 31 characters (29 CJK plus 2 punctuation), 62 per-character color cases; fixed 16x16 glyph and fallback bypass checks; final four-scene overview inspected at the recorded hash.

findings.detected_by: Independent reviewer during the Regular-glyph follow-up
findings.title: Legacy opening weather helper overlaid its older glyph on the new Regular fallback
findings.original_scenario: After Regular bitmaps were added, draw_weather_text first drew the generic Regular 雨/雹 and then drew the older WEATHER_GLYPHS bitmap because Font16 still lacked the character. 雨 expanded from 70 Regular pixels to 142 overlaid pixels; 雹 expanded from 78 to 146.
findings.required_action: Do not overlay a weather-only fallback when UI_GLYPHS already provides that character; retain fallback for genuinely uncovered weather characters.
findings.resolution: The weather helper now applies its old fallback only when the character is absent from UI_GLYPHS and missing from Font16.
findings.re_review_condition: Generic and opening-weather drawing must be byte-identical for the four fixed glyphs and rain/hail opening lines; preserve the old 肆/虐 fallback.
findings.verification_result: Passed: 雨70/雹78 opaque pixels on both paths, all four fixed glyphs and both opening lines byte-identical, 肆/虐 nonblank, seven tactical presentation regressions passed.

checks.name: independent-prefix-and-packet-probes
checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import copy,json,sys
sys.path[:0]=['tests','sim','tools/mockups']
from unittest.mock import patch
from test_tactical_presentation import TacticalPresentation
from test_tactical_combat import guarded_battle,strike
from animation_timeline import AnimationTimeline
TacticalPresentation.setUpClass(); test=TacticalPresentation()
full_battle=test.weather(); raw_before=copy.deepcopy(full_battle.events)
idx=next(i for i,e in enumerate(full_battle.events) if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_start')
truncated=copy.deepcopy(full_battle); truncated.events=copy.deepcopy(full_battle.events[:idx+1])+[(2.,'end',None)]
full=test.animation(full_battle); short=test.animation(truncated)
start=next(e[0] for e in full.timeline.events if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_start')
windows=[]
for delta in (0.,.2,.5):
 moment=start+delta
 for anim in (full,short):
  anim._presentation_view()._ensure(moment)
 vals=[a._presentation_view().weather_until-moment for a in (full,short)]
 assert vals[0]==vals[1] and abs(vals[0]-(8.-delta))<1e-8,vals
 assert full.playback_frame(moment).tobytes()==short.playback_frame(moment).tobytes()
 windows.append({'time':moment,'remaining_full':vals[0],'remaining_truncated':vals[1]})
assert full_battle.events==raw_before

b,a,protected,guard,bait=guarded_battle(attacker_teaching='surf')
strike(b,a,bait)
marker=next(e for e in b.events if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='guard')
owner=marker[5]['result_event_index']; boundary=owner+marker[5]['result_event_count']
a.energy=0;b._strike(a,protected,.1)
# Another unit's legal same-tick basic also lies beyond the closed packet.
protected.energy=0;b._strike(protected,a,.1)
for events in (b.events,json.loads(json.dumps(b.events))):
 tl=AnimationTimeline(events,b.units); main=next(a for a in tl.actions if a.source_index==owner)
 derived=[a for a in tl.actions if owner<a.source_index<=boundary]
 following=[a for a in tl.actions if a.source_index>boundary]
 assert derived and all(a.secondary and a.impact==main.impact for a in derived)
 assert len(following)==2 and all(not a.secondary for a in following)
 assert all(a.impact>main.impact for a in following)

weather_b,a,p,g,bait=guarded_battle(attacker_teaching='rain_dance')
weather_b._weather_sources[a.team]=a
strike(weather_b,a,bait)
m=next(e for e in weather_b.events if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='guard')
owner2=m[5]['result_event_index']; boundary2=owner2+m[5]['result_event_count']
request_i=next(i for i,e in enumerate(weather_b.events) if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_request')
assert owner2<request_i<=boundary2
weather_b.flush_tactics(.2)
start_i=next(i for i,e in enumerate(weather_b.events) if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_start')
assert start_i>boundary2
weather_b.events.append((1.,'end',None))
tl=AnimationTimeline(weather_b.events,weather_b.units)
main=next(a for a in tl.actions if a.source_index==owner2)
request=next(e for e in tl.events if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_request')
transition=next(e for e in tl.events if e[1]=='tactical_effect' and e[4]=='weather_start')
assert request[0]==main.impact and transition[0]>=main.impact
print(json.dumps({'weather_prefix_samples':windows,'prefix_pixels_equal':True,'raw_events_unchanged':True,'guard_surf_boundary':boundary,'following_same_tick_basics':len(following),'serialized_packet_preserved':True,'weather_request_inside_guard_packet':True,'weather_start_outside_guard_packet':True},ensure_ascii=False))
PY

checks.name: fixed-glyph-and-opening-weather-probe
checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
sys.path[:0]=['tools/mockups','sim']
from PIL import Image,ImageFont
from render_mockups import UI_GLYPHS,draw_text,text_width
from render_battle_gif import draw_weather_text,WEATHER_GLYPHS
from decoders import Font16
corpus='隆隆岩替卡比兽承受攻击！全场天气变为晴天雨天沙暴冰雹无天气晴雨冲突，恢复天气结束，恢复'
chars=sorted(set(corpus)); cjk=[c for c in chars if '\u4e00'<=c<='\u9fff']
assert len(chars)==31 and len(cjk)==29
with patch.object(ImageFont,'truetype',side_effect=AssertionError('system font must not load')),patch.object(ImageFont,'load_default',side_effect=AssertionError('system font must not load')):
 font=Font16()
 for char in chars:
  assert text_width(char)==16
  for color in ((41,44,53),(19,71,143)):
   image=Image.new('RGBA',(20,20));draw_text(image,(2,2),char,font,color)
   bbox=image.getbbox()
   assert bbox is not None and 2<=bbox[0]<bbox[2]<=18 and 2<=bbox[1]<bbox[3]<=18,(char,bbox)
   opaque=[image.getpixel((x,y)) for x in range(20) for y in range(20) if image.getpixel((x,y))[3]]
   assert set(opaque)=={(*color,255)},(char,set(opaque))
 counts={}
 for char in '晴承雨雹':
  rows=UI_GLYPHS[char]
  assert len(rows)==16 and all(len(row)==16 and set(row)<=set('01') for row in rows)
  with patch.object(font,'text',side_effect=AssertionError('fixed glyph fallback requested')):
   a=Image.new('RGBA',(16,16));draw_text(a,(0,0),char,font)
   b=Image.new('RGBA',(16,16));draw_weather_text(b,(0,0),char,font)
   assert a.getbbox() is not None and a.tobytes()==b.tobytes()
  counts[char]=sum(a.getpixel((x,y))[3]>0 for x in range(16) for y in range(16))
 for text in ('下雨了！','开始下冰雹了！'):
  a=Image.new('RGBA',(16*len(text),16));draw_text(a,(0,0),text,font)
  b=Image.new('RGBA',(16*len(text),16));draw_weather_text(b,(0,0),text,font)
  assert a.tobytes()==b.tobytes(),text
 for char in '肆虐':
  a=Image.new('RGBA',(16,16));draw_weather_text(a,(0,0),char,font)
  assert a.getbbox() is not None
print(json.dumps({'character_count':31,'cjk_count':29,'punctuation_count':2,'characters':''.join(chars),'nonblank_and_color_cases':62,'fixed_glyph_size':[16,16],'opaque_pixel_counts':counts,'weather_and_generic_fixed_glyphs_identical':True,'rain_and_hail_opening_lines_identical':True,'legacy_sand_fallback_preserved':True,'host_font_loading_blocked':True,'fixed_glyph_fallback_blocked':True,'source_sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in ('tools/mockups/render_mockups.py','tools/mockups/render_battle_gif.py')}},ensure_ascii=False))
PY
